video_title: Lionel Hollins on Deron Williams saying he wanted to FIGHT him and their "BEEF"  👀

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen recalls his frustration with Lionel Hollins' coaching style
quotes.excerpt: You average eight points for your career, man. Stop this 'I would have done this' stuff, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: I did not like Lionel Hollins because he used to do this stuff that would bug me so much. We used to be in film and he would be like, 'You know what I would have done? In this case, I would have done...' and I am like, 'Come on, man.' You average eight points for your career, man. Stop this 'I would have done this' stuff, man. You could not do nothing I could do on this court.

text_blocks.speaker: Lionel Hollins
text_blocks.text: I almost fought his old ass one time.

quotes.social_post: Tony Allen admits he almost fought Lionel Hollins during their time in Memphis because he was tired of the coach critiquing his game. He said I almost fought his old ass one time.

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins addresses his coaching philosophy and player opinions
quotes.excerpt: Whatever he said about me didn't matter, because I feel this way: whatever people's opinions are of me, ain't none of my business.
quotes.quote: Whatever he said about me didn't matter, because I feel this way: whatever people's opinions are of me, ain't none of my business. That's his business. That's how he felt, that's his business. I was just messing with you guys because everybody sent the tape. Everybody said, 'Oh, your boys didn't even defend you. Your boys didn't even defend you.' I said, 'Hey, I don't know why.' I said they should have, but you know, I'm not mad at them because they did.
quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins says he does not take player criticism personally. He said whatever people's opinions are of me, ain't none of my business.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph discusses his relationship with coach Lionel Hollins
quotes.excerpt: I really appreciate him coaching me like that, but for you, while we right here, everybody can't take that though, coach.
quotes.quote: His take on you wasn't my take. I really couldn't, I didn't have no rebuttal for it. I didn't have no, you know, try to struggle with it. I'm like, my time with him is my time with him. I don't, I love my time with him. I really appreciate him coaching me like that, but for you, while we right here, everybody can't take that though, coach. You know what I'm saying? Some of, everybody ain't cut from that. You remind me of my granddaddy, even to the day. When I hear him on the phone, listen to you, I'm picking up that game. But when you're upset, I know where you're coming from. I got to get straightened. I got to get straightened.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph explains why he got along with Lionel Hollins while others struggled. He said you remind me of my granddaddy, even to the day.

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins explains his defensive coaching expectations for Tony Allen
quotes.excerpt: How many times all-defense? Six times all-defense. You know, he six times all-defense.
quotes.quote: How many times all-defense? Six times all-defense. You know, he six times all-defense. We're in the game, right? And Tony runs away. He anticipates something happening on the other side. He leaves his man and run over there to do, fakes a pass, throws it over to Tony's man and he shoots. Tony comes to the bench at the time of, 'Man, this is some BS. I help y'all, I do this, and y'all can't help me.' I said, 'Tony, how the hell can anybody help you when they don't know where you are?'
quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins recalls a defensive disagreement with Tony Allen. He told Tony how the hell can anybody help you when they do not know where you are.

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins on Zach Randolph's desire to play 48 minutes
quotes.excerpt: When Zach was mad at me when I took him out of the game, because Zach wanted to play 48.
quotes.quote: When Zach was mad at me when I took him out of the game, because Zach wanted to play 48. I don't care if we were up 30, he wanted to play all 48. I was like to myself, I'm like, 'Dang, Zach, this dude didn't play in the week and now he going to get a chance to play 30 seconds and you mad?' He wanted all the burns. He wanted all the minutes. But Zach would come out of the game and the ball boy would run up and give him a towel. Zach would wrap his face and throw it right at my feet and go on to the bench.
quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins shares a story about Zach Randolph wanting to play every minute of every game. He said Zach would wrap his face in a towel and throw it right at my feet when he got subbed out.
